name: m41b_wide_prod
question: Does the longer-dose production candidate (14 epochs) beat its matched-dose narrow control? The 6-epoch arms were still climbing on val_acc, and M38's dose law (10 epochs overwrites) was measured on the NARROW encoder where there was nothing new to learn -- with 43 zero-init columns the right dose is an open question, so control and arm share the dose and differ only in width.
